instruction: Navigate to the second slide and set its title to "Renewable Resources".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to slide 2 (index 1) and setting the title to 'Renewable Resources'. The evaluator extracts the title text from slide index 1 and compares it with the expected text. Similar complexity to original task - simple text editing on a specific slide.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts title from slide 2 (index 1 in 0-based indexing) using python-pptx
Metric correctly compares title text with whitespace normalization for exact match
